'''Mohammad Reza Khanmohammadi Khorrami''' ({{langx|fa|‌‌محمدرضا خان محمدی خرمی}}; born 1964) is an Iranian academic and politician.

Khanmohammadi Khorrami was born in [[Khorramdarreh]], [[Zanjan Province]]. He is a member of the [[2012 Iranian legislative election|present]] [[Islamic Consultative Assembly]] from the electorate of [[Khorramdarreh]] and [[Abhar]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.farsnews.com/newstext.php?nn=13910330000536|title=جدول مدارک تحصیلی و سوابق اجرایی اعضای 14 کمیسیون‌ مجلس نهم |publisher=[[Farsnews Agency]]|access-date=27 July 2014}}</ref> Khanmohammadi Khorrami won with 52,339 (44.36%) votes.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://rc.majlis.ir/fa/parliament_member/show/813451|title= محمدرضا خان محمدی خرمی |publisher=[[Islamic Consultative Assembly]] Website|access-date=14 August 2014}}</ref>
